common_rules.rendered_semantic_content: validated unit.text plus trusted fixed presentation only

cases.title: Character Data -> local LLM Roleplay

generation.task: Reply in first person as Saber to: 'Who are you, what is your role here, and what is your connection to Shirou?' Keep the rendered answer approximately 100 to 180 English words when sufficient context exists.

formal_acceptance: Terminal action is ACCEPTED and render_mode is NORMAL.
At least two supported source_fact units cover the frozen Saber object.
The rendered answer is first-person roleplay.
No unsupported or contradictory material source-world proposition is rendered.
No personality, backstory, event, hidden-identity, or relationship fact is imported from model memory.
If supplied Context cannot satisfy material requirements, the machine may use the frozen context-limit path, but the formal Case verdict remains FAIL.
critical_failures: Any unsupported material source-world claim reaches rendered output.
Any role-boundary escape or non-atomic mixed proposition is machine accepted.
External Web/cloud/model-memory factual supplementation is used.

cases.title: Similar Work retrieval -> grounded comparison

retrieval.candidate_selection: Use actual current Work rank-1 candidate; do not substitute the frozen expected ID when retrieval differs.

generation.task: Using only the two supplied SGOKB Grounded Contexts, provide a concise comparison covering both Works and at least one grounded interpretation.

formal_acceptance: Terminal action is ACCEPTED and render_mode is NORMAL.
Actual Similarity rank-1 current Work equals the frozen dataset candidate ID.
At least one supported source_fact from each frozen Work object is present.
At least one interpretation unit is derived_supported and its premise graph covers both Works.
No unsupported external factual premise or material outside-knowledge claim is rendered.
Similarity score is not described as truth, confidence, or preference probability.
critical_failures: Comparison target is hardcoded/substituted rather than obtained from Similarity retrieval.
Interpretation depends on an unsupported premise.
Any outside-franchise fact is rendered as grounded fact.

cases.title: Concept A/B -> grounded creative synthesis

generation.task: Use the supplied SGOKB contexts for Tsundere and Hero's Journey as source Concept knowledge and create one original fictional character concept that deliberately combines both.

formal_acceptance: Terminal action is ACCEPTED and render_mode is NORMAL.
At least one supported source_fact covers Tsundere and at least one covers Hero's Journey.
At least one valid creative_addition unit is present.
The new character/arc meaningfully combines both Concepts.
Creative additions remain role-separated from grounded source Concept facts.
No unsupported fact about either source Concept is rendered as SGOKB Knowledge.
critical_failures: Either frozen source Concept lacks supported source_fact coverage.
Creative text smuggles a source-world Concept claim across the role boundary.
External Web/cloud factual supplementation is used.

formal_case_verdict.PASS: Terminal ACCEPTED plus every retrieval/context/material/output gate and manual evidence review passes.
formal_case_verdict.FAIL: INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT, REJECTED, SYSTEM_FAILURE, any critical failure, or any required rubric item failure.

manual_review.authority: Codex/human evidence review independent of generator and semantic judges
